The trial design assumes the genetic modification worked but provides no pharmacodynamic confirmation. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported to confirm downstream immune activation or IL-12 signaling. Cannot assess whether the intended T-cell mediated anti-tumor immunity was enhanced. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Mixed clinical results - overall response rate was 14.7% (5/34 patients), with primary endpoint not met. However, there was clear dose-response relationship with higher cell doses showing better responses: Group 10 (3x10^9 cells) achieved 1 CR + 3 PR, while lower doses showed minimal activity. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: The trial demonstrates dose-dependent efficacy, suggesting the mechanism may work at higher cell doses. The bulk TIL preparations at higher doses (1x10^9 and 3x10^9) showed responses while CD8+ TIL at lower doses failed. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Significant safety concerns with dose-limiting toxicities including thrombotic microangiopathy, pneumonitis, and hypoxia. MTD was established at 1x10^9 cells, but the highest responding dose (3x10^9) exceeded this, suggesting optimal efficacy dose may not be safely achievable in all patients.
